Case 48 is the "long query" case: I wrote `[[['a','b']*200], [['a','b']*200+['b']]]` inside `add(...)` which wraps each query with `list(q)` — so `queries` = `[[['a','b']*200], ...]` → each query is `[['a','b',...]]`, i.e., a list containing a list → not a list of strings → E_SCHEMA. My test bug: `add` expects `queries` as a list of paths; I passed a list whose elements are lists of paths. Fix: pass `[['a','b']*200, ['a','b']*200+['b']]`.

Let me fix.
